label: For actual concreta a,b at the selected world, if b is maximal in the SAME supplied…, via grades
meaning: If an actual concretum a grounded an actual maximum b in esse, a would be more in esse than b, which maximality (nothing is more in esse than b) excludes. So no actual concretum grounds a maximum at all, which gives the local asymmetry policy without any asymmetry premise. The InAct part of maximality is unused.
